about_the_game:
Flip Dice is a satisfying, strategy-first twist on match-3. Each tile is a six-sided die—you don’t swap tiles; you flip a die in the direction you choose, changing its top face to set up matches. Limited arrows per direction turn every click into a mini-puzzle: do you take the easy match now, or line up a bigger chain?

Clear lines of 3 or more to score, trigger cascades, and build combos for bonus points. Nail big clears to earn powerful tools—like a free directional flip, a 3×3 bomb, or a wild bomb that wipes every copy of a number. Hit your score goal to advance, carry your running score forward, and push for personal bests as levels ramp up.

Unlock new dice skins as you reach milestones, track detailed stats, and enjoy snappy feedback with clean effects and crisp audio. Whether you’ve got two minutes or twenty, Flip Dice is a frictionless “one more run” puzzle loop.

Features

  • Flip, don’t swap – Rotate any die up/down/left/right to change its top face and set up matches.

  • Meaningful constraints – Limited arrows per direction make every move count.

  • 8×8 match-3 core – Clear 3+ in a line, trigger cascades, and rack up combos.

  • Power-ups you earn –

    • Free Move: flip without spending an arrow

    • 3×3 Bomb: clear a block of tiles

    • Wild Bomb: pick a number and remove all of them

  • Level goals & progression – Beat the target, push onward, and stack a running score across levels.

  • Deep stats – Best scores, levels, match sizes, and per-number totals.

  • Skins to unlock – Earn fresh looks (Pastel, Neon, Galaxy, and more) as you progress.

  • Player aids – Hint for smart suggestions and Undo for last-move takebacks.

  • Instant sessions – Fast starts, quick restarts, zero waiting.

How to Play (optional section)

  • Click a die to select it, then choose a direction to flip.

  • Match 3+ of the same top number in a row/column to clear and score.

  • Create chains for combo bonuses and to earn power-ups.

  • Reach the level goal before you run out of arrows.

Accessibility & Options (optional blurb)

  • Mouse-first controls

  • Volume slider & mute toggle

  • Visual clarity with high-contrast dice faces and readable UI

System Requirements (Windows)

Minimum

  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit).

  • Processor: Intel/AMD 64-bit dual-core.

  • Memory: 4 GB RAM.

  • Graphics: Integrated graphics (DX11 capable).

  • Storage: 200 MB available space.

Recommended

  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit).

  • Processor: Intel i3/Ryzen 3 or better.

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM.

  • Graphics: Any modern integrated or discrete GPU.

  • Storage: 200 MB available space.

Suggested Store Tags

Puzzle • Match-3 • Strategy • Casual • Singleplayer • Colorful • Relaxing • Indie • 2D • Minimalist • Family-Friendly • Mouse-Only

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2 cores) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better, DirectX 11 compatible
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: 64-bit CPU/OS required. 1280×720 minimum resolution. Internet not required to play
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 3 (4 cores)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD 620 / any modern DX11-compatible GPU
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 700 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1920×1080 recommended. SSD recommended for faster load times.

short_description: Flip dice, chain matches, and trigger cascading combos in a tactile puzzle challenge. Plan your moves, earn power-ups, unlock skins, and climb ever-harder levels. Easy to learn, tough to master.
